summary: Bind PR preflight to the authoritative target instead of a stale adoption ticket

delivery.outcome: A new PR after a standard adoption passes the unchanged governance gate with its actual remote target base; invalid or missing target observations fail closed.
nonGoals: Change policy checks, trusted identities or branch protection.

architecture.decision: Resolve the configured remote target to an immutable commit before PR preflight and pass it explicitly to the existing managed gate.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded implementation through independently reviewed delivery.

validation.evidence: Real Git remote/base and failure-path regression coverage.
Protected publication, both Python CI jobs, post-merge CI and successful real ticket-095 preflight.
